description: Single-tenancy food fit-out in a retail precinct; dimension plan, RCP and storefront elevation. Answer key for the autonomous AI tasks (Card P). Room areas are calibrated reviewer traces (printed-dimension calibration agreed within 0.22%), not independent survey values.

rooms.label: Bar
rooms.note: Confirmed by the project contact 2026-10-05: the Bar is the walled central island. Area measured to the inside faces of its drawn partitions on the dimension plan (calibrated 11,825 mm dimension), not independently surveyed; it equals the enclosed-walls measurement, so for Bar the score tests naming, not geometry.

rooms.label: Shop
rooms.note: Confirmed by the project contact 2026-10-05: Shop is the dining area including the top-middle buffet stations, excluding the walled central Bar island. Area is the sum of the two enclosed areas measured to the inside faces of the drawn walls (calibrated 11,825 mm dimension), not independently surveyed; for Shop the score tests naming and merging.

edges.evidence: Storefront line; matches the 11,900 mm storefront elevation (p. 26). Confirmed by the project contact 2026-10-05: it faces an enclosed mall/walkway, not outdoors.

rooms.evidence: The Bar is the walled central island (confirmed by the project contact 2026-10-05); on the dimension plan (p. 20) it is surrounded by the dining area and the kitchen, so every Bar wall is internal.

glazed_panels.note: Glass continues above the 2,700 mm ceiling; head capped at the ceiling.

P5_roof.evidence: Confirmed by the project contact 2026-10-04: apartments above the retail precinct. Not determinable from the plans alone.

P6_kitchen.evidence: Keyed only from equipment named in text on the kitchen elevations (p. 30): RANGEHOOD (one island canopy, drawn in both elevations), OVEN, 3 DOOR FRIDGE, 2 DOOR FRIDGE, UB FRIDGE x2 in each elevation, ICE M[achine] (label partly cut off). The cooking island's burners, woks and fryers appear only as plan symbols without text, so they are not keyed. Sinks, hand basins and racks give no heat and are not keyed.
